title: WCAG 2.2
summary: WCAG 2.2 defines testable A/AA/AAA criteria; use Level AA as the project baseline and validate new 2.2 additions manually, not by scan alone.

MUST.text: State the conformance target (WCAG 2.2 Level AA) and scope for each feature before audit.

Assess new 2.2 AA criteria: 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum), 2.5.7 Dragging Movements, 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), 3.2.6 Consistent Help, 3.3.7 Redundant Entry, 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum).
Include keyboard, screen reader, zoom/reflow and high-contrast checks alongside automated scans.

SHOULD.text: Document exceptions and any AAA criteria considered but not required.
Re-test after UI changes affecting focus, input, help or authentication.

AVOID.text: Do not claim conformance from an automated scan alone.
Do not label AAA as AA or treat advisory techniques as requirements.

DECIDE.decision: Define AA scope with team before design

EXAMPLE.good: "Audit notes SC 2.5.8 target size 24x24 CSS px and documents a justified exception."

FAILURE_MODES: Automated tools catch only a subset; manual checks find focus obscurity and auth barriers.
Treating AAA as AA inflates conformance claims.
New 2.2 criteria are often missed in legacy checklists.
